title: Close a harness task whose claim base the coordinator moved forward
goal: When origin/main moves during a mission, the native coordinator reconciles the worktree at its next commit and advances the claim's base, while the task record keeps the base it was claimed at. SusiTarget::close then refused its own accepted task with 'task is not owned by this native reservation', so any mission that overlapped a landing on main could not finish. Close accepts a record whose base is an ancestor of the claim's base; every other ownership check is unchanged.

reuse.searched: crates/susi-harness adapter.rs (close, claim, base_is_ancestor, the git runner), xtask local_workflow sync_commit.rs (reconcile_claimed_worktree_locked advances the claim base) and native_provenance.rs (task_for_claim does not bind the record to a base).
reuse.reason: One ancestry check through the adapter's existing git runner; nothing new is built.
